body:
Me and a good friend of mine had a date to go get some stuff at the smartshop in Holland, Roosendaal. So we met at about 13:00 and went on my motorcycle. When we got there we bought Philosophers stones, Salvia Divinorum, Mexican Magic Mushrooms and Yellow Jacket.
On the way back home I suggested we took the philosophers stones and go to a nice place somewhere in nature. So we took them around 15:00 h. The taste wasn't bad at all. It tasted like walnuts with somewhat sour/salty aftertaste. My friend (I'll call him X) said he already felt something. But knowing he wasn't that experienced I told him it was just a placebo.
A half an hour went by and I still didn't feel anything. We finally found a really beautiful place in some forest. No people to be found and birds chirping. We drank some water with mint in it and I asked X if he felt anything. He didn't feel any differant and neither did I. So he said: 'let's smoke the salvia.' And I found it to be a really great idea. The man in the smartshop told us we should sit down because it would really hit hard at once. The salvia we bought was the mild one (5x) and on the package stood: 'you'll ascend when you blow out.' It was our first time smoking salvia. We did not have a bong or pipe but I did have some tubes to make cigarettes. So I did it in the 'machine' (I don't know the word in English) and did all the salvia in it. It wasn't really a lot and I was sceptical about it, thinking it wouldn't affect me.
We sat down in the grass and lighted the salvia cigarette. Before we lighted it I told X: 'we gotta be careful with the ash that it won't fall of so that the remaining salvia falls out.' I took a big toke of the cigarette and held it as long as I could in my lungs and passed it to X. He did the same and passed it back. Then with the second toke I started to feel the effects and then the ash dropped of and a little bit of salvia fell on the ground. X didn't want to let any go to waste so he grabbed the burning ash with his bare hands and tried to inhale the smoke coming out of it. It looked so funny I started laughing uncontrollably hard and I stood up laughing my ass off!! My legs felt really light what was strange cause I would expect that my head would feel light.
And suddenly everything looked like a painting and I kept on laughing and feeling soooo high. Then I thought this moment had happened before in a parallel life or a previous life or in a dream I had before. It felt like the first time I smoked marijuana: feeling funny and laughing so hard about stupid things. We we're having so much fun laughing about the things we were saying. It lasted for about 15 minutes. And when we came down there was absolutely nothing bad about it. No hard coming down, just easy fading away of the magical high.
X said : 'let's take the magical Mushrooms!!' but I thought maybe it's because he's still high .. So I said: 'wait just ten more minutes before you decide that.' Anyway when we came down I didn't feel anything differant anymore. So for me the philosophers stones didn't do anything
for me the philosophers stones didn't do anything
. Maybe I didn't ingest enough or maybe it's just such a tiny differance that only someone would feel who has never had any other drug before, I don't know.
We decided to keep the magic mushrooms and the yellow jackets for the evening. So about 21:00 h we ingested the mushrooms and took the yellow and black striped yellow jackets. We stayed up till about 1:00 h and I felt just plain high (which I think were the mushrooms) but not trippy. The effects of Yellow Jacket was just a raised heartbeat and not being able to sleep. We then just went to bed not being able to sleep. The night wasn't as interesting as when we smoked the salvia.
I definitely want to try the strong version of the salvia divinorum cause it really surprised me and I had so much fun with it.
